notes.title: Leveldesign Update and small changes
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone,[/b]

The levels are gradually being updated and made more beautiful. So far level 01 has been redesigned and now also level 03.

Furthermore, the key assignment has been adjusted and the key assignment can be viewed via (keyboard) "C" or (gamepad) "directional pad up". (I'm still working on the design)
The arrow keys can now also be used to play on the keyboard.

Otherwise I was able to optimize the code a little bit.

Have fun playing! :)

notes.title: Release
notes.notes: Unfortunately, there are still minor bugs such as music that plays at the default volume after starting the game in the first level, although the volume has been adjusted in the menu. After opening the menu and restarting a level, however, everything is fine. But that's nothing that can't be fixed!
